builders.note: v20 (Ryno 2026-10-18 item 5; PROVISIONAL): 2 builders from the start; the 3rd is the reward for the lodge's reward_at_stars (2★), or bought early for extra_slot_bb Bush Bucks.

timers.note: v20 (Ryno 2026-10-18 items 1-3; PROVISIONAL): nothing stalls the first session. A build or upgrade costing under instant_cost_minutes_of_income of the camp's income (IncomeModel.camp_rate, at least income_floor_per_h) is instant, and everything is instant below instant_below_stars (up to 1★). A timer with free_finish_min or less left finishes free; any timer finishes for coins: minutes left x income a minute x coin_skip_mult.

updates.note: v20 (Ryno 2026-10-18 item 13; PROVISIONAL): Google Play In-App Updates. At launch, with an update on Play, a flexible prompt ("A new version is ready: Update") at most every flexible_every_h hours; a build below min_version_code (remote config, 0 = never) gets the immediate, blocking update.

intro.note: v20 (Ryno 2026-10-18 items 6-7; PROVISIONAL): the first session's pace, while the player is in the game (never in the catch-up of time away), with missions 1 to intro running, or in the first pace_sessions sessions while the lodge is below pace_below_stars (the 1-star camp, where every build is instant too: a scripted player finished the intro in 5 minutes and then waited 270 s at the normal pace; all through the 1-star camp it brought Okavango two days early in balance_sim). Arrivals fly at frequency_scale instead of flights.frequency_scale (Hoedspruit every 60 s) and turn round in turnaround_mult of their time (the one stand frees for the next minute's landing), transfers take transfer_mult of transfers.transfer_s and guest drives leave every drive_cooldown_min (the one game vehicle has time for drives between runs), guests stay stay_min game minutes, and guests' tips wait in the lodge's tip jar for a tap (Collect), paid by themselves after tip_jar_auto_collect_s and at once while away or after the intro missions, so none is ever lost. With clear_landings nothing stops these arrivals: no night (flare-path lights), storm or wet-strip closure, at fair-weather demand (a first session started in the game's night slot waited up to 20 minutes for a landing).

coin_chests.note: M8.5 v14 (Ryno 2026-10-18; Hotel Empire / Idle Airport pattern): Shop chests of coins for Bush Bucks. A chest holds `hours` of the camp's current coins an hour (IncomeModel.camp_rate: arrivals, rooms, fuel; at least min_coins_per_hour), rounded to price_sig_figs, priced at the buy-the-difference rate (bb_rate_base x bb_rate_growth^(level-1) coins a Bush Buck) less its bulk discount, rounded up.

flights.booking_note: v19 (Ryno 2026-10-18 item 35): arrivals are bookings: a flight carries guests only for the beds free when it lands (free now less every other booking, plus checkouts due before its approach and taxi are over) and does not launch with none; at most max_waiting_aircraft wait on a stand for beds, the rest keep holding. PROVISIONAL.

lodge.stay_note: M8.5 v15 (Ryno 2026-10-18, v14 playtest: 2 h stays stalled the guest flow): a guest stays stay_min_by_star[lodge stars - 1] game minutes (at x1, PROVISIONAL), whatever the tier, and at checkout pays its room for its tier's stay_nights (guests.json) at the nightly rate (nightly x unit mult x (1 + nightly amenities) x nightly_scale), however short the stay, with its tip: a guest is worth what it was (balance_sim: every target met with no rate changed, free Bush Bucks 13.1 a day against 8-13). Wages leave the coins (the offline bank while away, never below zero) at each game-day boundary. The FSA charter keeps its own nights.
lodge.rating_note: v17 (Ryno 2026-10-18; PROVISIONAL): the headline guest rating (lodge panel) is the average of the last review_window reviews' ratings; before the first review it shows the rating formula's value (SPEC.md section 7), which still sets demand (pull) and the charter's eligibility.

wildlife.drive_note: M8.5 v16 (Ryno 2026-10-18: every guest gets a game drive during the stay; PROVISIONAL): besides the dawn and dusk drives (outings.drive, the better odds of those slots), a guest drive leaves on demand, rolling outings.drive.rolls with the current slot's odds, for the guests in camp who have not had a drive: when at least drive_min_guests of them wait, or one has waited drive_max_wait_frac of its stay, once drive_cooldown_min[lodge stars - 1] game minutes (divided by the vehicles) have passed since the last drive. Only its riders count its sightings; any drive marks the guests present as having had one.

transfers.note: v17 (Ryno 2026-10-18 items 14 and 15; PROVISIONAL values): no taps. Received guests walk walk_s to the waiting area; a game vehicle (as many as the drive vehicles: wildlife.outings.drive base_count plus drives_per_slot) drives transfer_s each way along the road, carries vehicle_seats a run, and drops them at the lodge, where their stay starts. Leavers ride out from the lodge the same way and wait at the waiting area to board. A guest drive leaves only with a vehicle free (transfers first). The waiting area (building terminal_shelter, levels 0 to 3) seats `seats`; arrivals who find a seat tip tip_bonus more.
